name: env-recording-studio
description: A warm recording room built in real 3D: mixing desk with three screens and studio monitors, acoustic panels and bass traps, record shelves, a lounge corner and glowing ceiling strips. The 3 m in front of you stays clear for your build.
author: Spatial

name: env-park-stage
description: An outdoor concert in a park: band shell and stage 10 m ahead with PA stacks and a light truss, low-poly trees, bushes and flowers all around, log benches, rolling hills and a gradient sky with drifting clouds.
author: Spatial

name: env-music-hall
description: A grand concert hall in real 3D: proscenium stage with red curtains and orchestra chairs under a warm spotlight, raked velvet seating behind you, a gilded balcony, columns, a coffered ceiling and glowing chandeliers.
author: Spatial
